propositions: Compiled state tracks plan_review_phase (planning|execution) distinct from prompt execution_mode, updated only by winning status targets: in_progress→execution, open→planning, others preserve current value.
Manifest format emits review-phase and optional priority-floor (0.80 for execution only) as fixed-order tokens; legacy absent manifestsparse as planning.
Phase compatibility validation accepts planning+planning/legacy and execution+execution(floor>=0.80); rejects execution+planning and execution+execution(floor<0.80) as incompatible.
Pre-sign generation captures immutable PlanReviewGeneration before LLM; stable generation equal to initial generation signs under one lock; any other stable change returns unsigned stale.
Re-sign refuses incompatible/malformed phase by parsing v2 JSON sidecar fields and comparing to current compiled phase; uses recorded review-time values not newly inferred phase.
